exact_claim: On label-skew CIFAR-10, Clipped ASGD shows a 1.2x improvement over vanilla ASGD at D=4 and a 1.3x improvement at D=8 (Figure 4).
selection: D=4 and D=8 winners were selected using seed 20260729 over the complete paper learning-rate and clipping-radius grids.
validation: Evaluate the four locked winners on unseen seeds 20260730, 20260731, and 20260732, without reselection.
uncertainty: Use all 3^3 paired seed bootstrap resamples and include the adverse endpoints of the 200-time-unit observation cadence.
verified_rule: All runs reach 70%; for each delay the combined 95% interval has lower endpoint >1 and contains the paper caption value.
blocked_rule: If the verified rule is not met, return BLOCKED, not FALSIFIED, because material author protocol details are unavailable.
negative_control: Every untrained initialization must remain below 70% test accuracy.
non_circularity: Seeds and winner settings are locked before validation; caps are copied from the paper and are not derived from observed outcomes.
